main_text.head: ק
main_text.p: קָב m. Cabus, fexta pars סָאָה Sati.
קִבֵּל Pihel Accepit, Recepit, Suscepit. Chal. קַבֵּל, & Fut. תְּקַבְּלוּן Recipietis. Dan.2.6.
קֳבֵל Coram, Ex adverso, Adversus. Chald.
לְקָבֵל Idem: item Propter, Propterea: מִלֵּי Propter verba, לְקָבֵל דְּנָה Propter hoc, Propterea, Eo quod, Quandoquidem: לְקָבְלָךְ Ex adversô tui, Dan.2.31.
קוּבַע m. Galea. קַבַּעַת f. Fax.
קָבַץ קָבֵּץ Collegit, Congregavit, Comportavit, Coutraxit. Niphal נִקְבַּץ. Pyhal קָבַּץ Congregari. Hithpahel הִתְקַבֵּץ Congregare se.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are approximate transcriptions; the scan is faded and heavily stained, so vowel points and some Hebrew letters are uncertain. The large letter ק is the section letter of the page.
